name: 27253 · Graham, NC
findings: ZIP 27253 (Graham) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27253 (Graham) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27253 (Graham) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).
